Grouped equal-frequency quartile bins (Stata's xtile ..., nq(4))

Source: R/utils-panel.R
quartile_bin.Rd

Thin wrapper around statar::xtile() documenting the contract this package relies on: NA in, NA out; non-missing values split into n groups of (approximately) equal size, numbered 1..n. Callers are responsible for applying this only within already-grouped data (this package additionally imposes a minimum group size of 50 before calling this at all — see compute_predictors()).

Usage

quartile_bin(x, n = 4)

Arguments

x

A numeric vector.

n

Number of equal-frequency bins (default 4, i.e. quartiles).

Value

An integer vector of bin numbers 1..n (or NA).

Details

Stata's own xtile uses a percentile algorithm equivalent to R's quantile(type = 2) (see percentile_stata()). statar::xtile() is an independent reimplementation; its quartile assignments matched Stata 19.5 exactly in the reproduction runs (every predictor type and desc_predictors cell, nine synthetic scenarios), provided the input is stored as Stata stores it (float, see stata_float()).
